title: Recommended Settings
description: List of in-product settings the catalog recommends users review or change. Designed to be consumable by the local-sspm Chrome extension to verify the user's actual configuration.

settings.description: All recommended settings for the service. Order is meaningful only for display.

key.description: Stable slug identifying the setting within the service (e.g. 'ai-training-opt-out').

title.description: Short human-readable title for the setting.

description.description: Longer explanation of what the setting controls and why it matters. Markdown allowed.

default.description: Vendor's out-of-the-box value for the setting before any user action.

recommended.description: Value the catalog recommends a privacy-conscious user adopt.

applicable_plans.description: Plan slugs this setting applies to. Use the same slugs as the plan files.

settings_url.description: Deep-link URL to the in-product settings screen, if a stable one exists.

settings_path.description: Ordered breadcrumb of menu labels a user follows to reach the setting (e.g. ['Settings', 'Privacy']).

verification_method.description: How the local-sspm extension can verify the current value of this setting.

selector.description: CSS or XPath selector when type=dom_selector.

expected_text.description: Substring expected on the page when the setting is in the recommended state.

severity.description: How strongly the catalog recommends this setting.

last_verified.description: Date a human last confirmed this entry against the live product.
